scenes.title: Frame the empty centre
scenes.action: Three cropped corner accents arrive on the motif, leaving the centre clear for the mark. The original app icon arrives on 1.76, with no Material Symbol badges.

scenes.title: Pop the mark, swing the lid
scenes.action: The large central mark pops, then its intact lid swings around the right lip on 2.32. The camera pans to the lower launcher and the handle stays attached.

scenes.title: Track four live cards
scenes.action: Four cards rise from the measured mouth into separate lanes. The camera alternates large widget faces with wider card views, then pulls wide around the chest.

scenes.title: Join and enter the screen
scenes.action: The cards join into a full-height connected bento beside giant whole-word type. Connected corners ease to 8 px. A shape wipe and close push carry the same cards into their real screen positions.

scenes.title: Enter the tools
scenes.action: The camera moves along a rail of live Compass, Level, Flashlight and SOS crops. Full-frame faces alternate with wider context. The cards return to a large phone, huge Quick tools type takes the left side, and the camera enters the measured Measure tab.

scenes.title: Angles, units, split and count
scenes.action: The real tab uses shared-axis motion. The Protractor grows from its measured screen rectangle, followed by a large Converter, Bill Splitter and landscape Counter. Shape wipes from each outgoing card carry the next framing.

scenes.title: Spin, then land three results
scenes.action: The wheel circle grows from its real card while Let chance decide crosses the left side. The wheel fills nearly the whole height, spins to Sushi, then expands back into its card as the camera pulls wide. Number, die and coin land on consecutive onsets.

scenes.title: Fan the destinations, land in gold
scenes.action: Three large devices enter as a fan with depth. Quick Tools, Measure and Play & Decide are labelled below. The original mark, headline and Play badge hold 27.90 to 29.40, before the original gold ending covers the frame and the mark lands on 29.80.
